name: rosetta-sailors-coconuts-and-a-monkey-problem
code:
use default

satisfies_tale(total: int, sailors: int) -> bool is
    let pile mut = total

    for _ in 1::sailors do
        if pile % sailors != 1 then return false fi
        pile = pile - 1 - (pile - 1) / sailors
    od

    pile % sailors == 0
si

hidden_piles(total: int, sailors: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let pile mut = total

    for _ in 1::sailors do
        yield (pile - 1) / sailors
        pile = pile - 1 - (pile - 1) / sailors
    od
si

for sailors in [5, 6] do
    if let total = stream(sailors, c => c || c + 1)
        |> find(c => satisfies_tale(c, sailors)) then
        write_line("{sailors} sailors: smallest pile is {total} coconuts")
        write_line("  piles hidden at night: {hidden_piles(total, sailors) |> join(", ")}")
    fi
od
